{{Otheruses|Combine}}
An '''agricultural combine''' was a collective with farming goals.

A certain agricultural combine in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] once bought a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class medium freighter]] and called it [[Twi'lek Dancer|''Harvest'']]. Once they had funds to buy a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], they retired and sold the ''Harvest.''
